name: Hasan Piker
role: American left-wing Twitch streamer and political commentator (born 1991)
summary: Piker is a self-described Marxist and socialist commentator who supports public ownership, universal healthcare, workplace democracy and labor power, and opposes US imperialism and Zionism. He is critical of the Democratic Party establishment while backing left candidates such as Zohran Mamdani and engaging in electoral politics. He praises aspects of China's development and treats provocation as part of his streaming style.

notes: Quiz answers come from a 60-question quiz on stream (s1); he misread or joked on several items and those were excluded. Interview material (s3, s5, s6) is partly secondhand write-ups, so many positions stay null. Statements about Hamas, Oct 7 and China are contested and are not mapped to statements here without a direct match. Later pass 2026-11-13 (rules 7): sources tagged by evidence. Four answers that rested only on the Wikipedia article (limit-guns, dictatorship-of-proletariat, workplace-democracy, settler-state-colonial) are nulled: the Current Affairs (2025), Stanford Daily (2026), i-D and Axios/Deseret interviews and the quiz-stream captions were searched for guns, workers' control, the dictatorship of the proletariat and settler colonialism and hold no statement. recognise-genocide is answered from the Current Affairs interview.
